conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion signal based on the 50-period Z-Score of the range_ratio to identify potential exhaustion points in volatility, serving as a contrarian filter for existing trend-following entries.
rationale: The original failure was due to an unexecutable engine reference. By utilizing a primitive, we isolate the volatility exhaustion signal from the complex statistical arbitrage framework, enabling direct integration into the existing TRY test infrastructure.
